id.description: F-### for follower, L-### for leader. Stable; never reused.

slug.description: URL slug, unique across all steps, frozen at first publish and never changed (ADR-0002)

title_short.description: Builder-facing rewording of title for tight chrome (step nav, lists). Must name the same parts and action as title; the h1 keeps title.

extends.description: Inherit every field from this step (any assembly) and override only what is listed here. Resolved by scripts; both steps keep their own URL (ADR-0002).

prep.description: Preparation step: the listed parts are handled (cleaned, configured, pre-wired) but not installed. Renderers highlight them without treating them as built.

parts.description: parts.yaml ids installed in this step

servo_slot.description: joint name resolved via servos.yaml for this assembly

cables.description: cables.yaml ids routed or connected in this step (drawn by the viewer); cable_path stays as an inline override

check.description: Verification the builder performs before moving on

instructions.description: Free-text detail for the builder; must not introduce facts absent from source

provenance.description: How the part role or placement was established (e.g. a placement check in the upstream STEP). Rendered with the sources, never as an instruction.
